html.description: The body of the email to send, in HTML format.

text.description: The body of the email to send, in plain text format.

to.description:
The email address to send notifications to. Required if including an
`email` object in your request body.

id.description: The ID of the responder. Cannot be set if `name` or `username` are set.

name.description: The name of the responder. Cannot be set if `id` or `username` are set.

username.description: The username of the responder. Cannot be set if `id` or `name` are set.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the Notifier was created. Cannot be set by clients.

discard.description:
If `true`, enables the `discard` integration, which discards all
notifications. Cannot be set if another integration is set.

email.description:
If an object is specified, sends notifications through an email integration.
Cannot be set if another integration is set.

name.description: The name of the Notifier. You can modify this value after the Notifier is created.

ops_genie.description:
If an object is specified, sends notifications through an Opsgenie integration.
Cannot be set if another integration is set.

pagerduty.description:
If an object is specified, sends notifications through a PagerDuty integration.
Cannot be set if another integration is set.

skip_resolved.description:
If `true`, disables notifications for resolved alerts. Cannot be set if
`discard` equals `true`.

slack.description:
If an object is specified, sends notifications through a Slack integration.
Cannot be set if another integration is set.

slug.description: The unique identifier of the Notifier. If a `slug` isn't provided, one is generated based on the `name` field. You can't modify this field after the Notifier is created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the Notifier was last updated. Cannot be set by clients.

victor_ops.description:
If an object is specified, sends notifications through a VictorOps integration.
Cannot be set if another integration is set.

webhook.description:
If an object is specified, sends notifications through a webhook integration.
Cannot be set if another integration is set.

basic_auth.description:
If an object is specified, sets an `Authorization` header with the
values of `password` and `username`. Cannot be set if `bearer_token` is
set.

bearer_token.description: Sets a token for bearer authentication. Cannot be set if `basic_auth` is set.

proxy_url.description:
Your proxy URL. (This parameter is deprecated, and custom proxies are
unsupported.)

insecure_skip_verify.description: If `true`, disables validation of the server certificate.

api_key.description:
Your Opsgenie API key. Required if including an `ops_genie` object in your
request body.

api_url.description:
The Opsgenie API URL to send requests to. Required if including an
`ops_genie` object in your request body.

details.description:
A set of key/value pairs with additional information about the alert. These
key/value pairs can include any arbitrary data.

priority.description: The priority level of alert. Possible values are `P1`, `P2`, `P3`, `P4`, and `P5`.

responders.description: List of responders responsible for notifications.

source.description: A backlink to the sender of the notification.

tags.description: A comma-separated list of tags attached to the notifications.

client.description: The client identification of the notification sender.

client_url.description: A backlink to the sender of the notification.

component.description: The part or component of the affected system that is broken.

details.description:
A set of key/value pairs with additional information about the incident. These
key/value pairs can include any arbitrary data.

group.description: A cluster or grouping of services.

images.description: Images to attach to the incident.

links.description: Links to attach to the incident.

routing_key.description:
Your PagerDuty integration key, if using the PagerDuty integration type
`Events API v2`. Cannot be set if `service_key` is set.

service_key.description:
Your PagerDuty integration key, if using the PagerDuty integration type
`Prometheus`. Cannot be set if `routing_key` is set.

severity.description:
The severity of the incident. Possible values: `critical`, `error`,
`warning`, or `info`.

url.description: The Pagerduty URL to send API requests to.

api_url.description:
Your Slack webhook API URL. Required if including a `slack` object in
your request body.

channel.description: The channel to send notifications to.

username.description: The user to send notifications to.

api_key.description:
Your VictorOps API key. Required if including a `victor_ops` object in
your request body.

api_url.description:
The VictorOps API URL. Required if including a `victor_ops` object in your
request body.

entity_display_name.description: A summary of the alerted problem.

message_type.description:
The behavior of the alert. Possible values are `CRITICAL`, `WARNING`, and
`INFO`.

monitoring_tool.description: The monitoring tool from which the state message originated.

routing_key.description:
Your VictorOps routing key. Required if including a `victor_ops` object in
your request body.

state_message.description: A detailed explanation of the alerted problem.

url.description:
Your webhook URL. This URL will be called as a `POST` request. Required
if including a `webhook` object in your request body.
